per_faculty.note: research/runners/affective_tom_production_organ.py (W5, default-ON since 2026-08-26). BRAIN_AFFECTIVE_TOM_GRADED defaults ON (unset->'1'), so observe_turn() takes the GRADED-circumplex branch and populates 'tone_level'/'reason', NOT the bistable 'tone_sign' (which stays at its unused init value 0 on that branch) -- the compared field must be 'reason'/'tone_level', not 'tone_sign'. On 'Maria is devastated' (a genuine third-party negative-affect trigger, detect_other_agent's own worked example), intact reads reason='empathic' with a non-zero tone_level; BRAIN_AFFECTIVE_TOM_LESION=1 clamps the OTHER-model's affect_out -> the differential collapses -> reason='lesion_collapsed', tone_level back to the neutral bucket.
